runtime_finding.behavior: OperaRoshanActor maps work to zero-based atlas row 2 and loops columns 0 through 3 at 7 fps. _play_roshan_task_pose uses REVIEWED_WORK_POSES only for Doctor, Farmer and Racer; Chef, Detective and Magician therefore receive the generic four-cell work loop in every work phase.
runtime_finding.semantic_risk: Each reviewed sheet row is a set of authored gesture keys. Reusing the full row for phases with different owned props can imply an unrelated action even when the phase widget is correct.
runtime_finding.motion_quality_boundary: Sheet inspection establishes pixel content and semantic mismatch only. It does not establish timing, cadence, transition quality, mounted occlusion or device readability.
runtime_finding.clarification: The current task uses _play_roshan_task_pose through _open_task/_on_gesture; phase and animation ownership must be checked in the exact future callback before implementation.

careers.work_row_pixels: All four cells show Roshan holding a pink mixing bowl and whisk or utensil. Arm, utensil and bowl contents vary, but the prop remains a mixing bowl.

phases.name: MIX
phases.basis: The bowl is readable and the least emphatic whisk motion; acceptable only if the mounted pour widget owns the pitcher/batter action.

phases.name: STIR
phases.basis: The vertical whisk planted in the bowl most directly supports stirring.

phases.name: BAKE
phases.basis: No work-row cell shows oven watching, a mitt, a baked cake or removal from the oven.

phases.name: FROST
phases.basis: No work-row cell shows piping bag, frosting ribbon or finished cake.

phases.name: TOP
phases.basis: No work-row cell shows placing toppings or presenting a finished cake.

careers.unrelated_prop_cycle: Confirmed for BAKE, FROST and TOP: the current loop repeatedly displays mixing-bowl work during different tasks. MIX/STIR share the bowl fiction, though a four-cell loop still needs mounted review before it can be called coherent motion.
evidence_gaps: mounted capture for each phase with widget and actor visible

careers.work_row_pixels: All four cells show magnifier investigation: looking down, holding the lens near the face, raising it, or looking through it. No case board, crown or chest appears.

phases.name: SEARCH
phases.basis: Roshan visibly looks through the magnifier, the clearest match for sweeping a lens across painted clues.

phases.name: CASE BOARD
phases.basis: The sheet has no pointing, matching, board or clue-placement state. A magnifier pose may remain as a neutral detective identity only if mounted evidence shows the board fully owns the action; it must not be called a match pose.

phases.name: CROWN
phases.basis: The sheet has no chest, spotlight answer, crown or reveal pose.

careers.unrelated_prop_cycle: Confirmed for CASE BOARD and CROWN: the current loop cycles lens-search gestures throughout board matching and the crown/chest answer. SEARCH is semantically related, but sheet cells alone do not prove a good loop.
evidence_gaps: mounted SEARCH capture showing lens ownership

careers.work_row_pixels: The work row changes magical effect meaning across cells: yellow energy wrapping Roshan, a yellow overhead loop, a violet circular spell plane, and a large gold-violet portal. The wand remains present, but these are distinct trick states rather than neutral in-betweens.

phases.name: VANISH
phases.basis: The contained wand glow and wrapping energy is the closest source-supported disappearance/casting state, conditional on Lamba and hat remaining visibly owned by the specialist surface.

phases.name: TRACK
phases.basis: No cell shows watching or selecting a shuffled glowing hat.

phases.name: ROPE
phases.basis: The long yellow loop is the nearest visual match to a magic rope/ribbon, but it is only conditional; mounted evidence must prove it does not read as an unrelated spell orbit.

phases.name: CABINET
phases.basis: No work-row cell shows cabinet doors, a downward pull or an opening reveal.

phases.name: PORTAL
phases.basis: The large gold-violet portal is the direct source-supported portal state.

careers.unrelated_prop_cycle: Confirmed game-wide within this work row: the generic loop rotates energy wrap, rope-like loop, spell plane and portal during every phase. This changes the depicted trick independently of VANISH, TRACK, ROPE, CABINET and PORTAL.

next_batch_protocol: Add a reviewed phase-to-cell mapping only where the existing source pixels directly support the phase. A null recommendation is a required evidence/art gap, not permission to choose a visually pleasant cell.
Keep the approved atlas files unchanged. The containment change, if implemented later, should select AtlasTexture cells through the existing show_pose path.
Capture every affected phase under Mobile 1280x720 with actor and phase-owned prop visible. Verify identity, prop meaning, contact, occlusion and phone readability independently.
Leave animation quality unassessed until a time-based capture proves transitions and cadence. A held cell can remove semantic contradiction but does not itself satisfy animation quality.
